global: This shio broth, clear and golden-brown with gentle ripples, sits in a white ceramic bowl with red rim and green dragon pattern. Tender chashu pork and a pink spiral naruto fish cake float in the glossy soup on a wooden table with warm brown tones.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters around its edge.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-brown, and glossy, with thin noodles submerged and floating, showing gentle ripples on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and a glossy surface, cut into a curved, irregular shape.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: white base with pink spiral swirl, scalloped edge, smooth surface, slightly translucent.
